title: Microwave Applesauce
description: Honeycrisp apples cooked with cinnamon and lemon in the microwave, then mashed.

steps.do: Peel and core the apples. Quarter each one, then cut each quarter crosswise about five times — more or fewer depending on how big the apple is. You want small, even pieces.
Put everything in a microwave-safe casserole dish: apples, water, sugar, cinnamon, lemon juice. Stir until every piece is coated.
Microwave 7–8 minutes on high. Stir it all around again.
Mash to the texture you want, and eat.

notes: Steam. The dish and the liquid come out very hot. Uncover away from your face and use a towel on the sides.
Texture. Mash lightly for chunky, longer for smooth. If it looks loose, it thickens as it cools.
Sweetness. Honeycrisp are sweet already — the sugar can come down if you like it tart. Taste after the first mash.
Keeping it. Refrigerate up to a week. Good warm or cold.

Other apples. McIntosh and Cortland collapse fastest — check a couple minutes early. Golden Delicious, Fuji, and Gala are sweeter, so cut the sugar to ¼ cup and taste. Granny Smith is firm and tart: full sugar, plus 2–3 extra minutes. Braeburn, Jonagold, and Pink Lady behave like Honeycrisp. A mix of one that falls apart and one that holds gives the best texture.
